WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    GREATEST(
      (
        LEAST(
          p.end_time,
          COALESCE((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM $__timeTo()::timestamptz) * 1000)::bigint, p.end_time)
        ) -
        GREATEST(
          p.start_time,
          COALESCE((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) * 1000)::bigint, p.start_time)
        )
      ) / 5000.0,
      1
    ) AS bucket_len,
    GREATEST(
      p.start_time,
      COALESCE((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) * 1000)::bigint, p.start_time)
    ) AS effective_start,
    LEAST(
      p.end_time,
      COALESCE((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM $__timeTo()::timestamptz) * 1000)::bigint, p.end_time)
    ) AS effective_end
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE p.partition_name = '$Zoom'
)
SELECT
  to_timestamp(
    floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0
  ) AS time,
  AVG(thermal.ambient_temp) AS ambient_temp
FROM thermal
JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = thermal.packet_id
JOIN bounds ON true
JOIN partitions p ON p.partition_name = '$Zoom'
WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY time;

unnested AS (
    SELECT 
        to_timestamp(
          floor(p.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0
        ) AS time,
        UNNEST(t.cells_temp[1:28]) AS value
    FROM thermal t
    JOIN packet p ON p.packet_id = t.packet_id
    JOIN bounds ON true
    JOIN partitions part ON part.partition_name = '$Zoom'
    WHERE p.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end
)
SELECT
    time,
    MIN(value) AS min_value,
    MAX(value) AS max_value,
    (MAX(value) - MIN(value))/2 AS avg_value,
    MAX(value) - MIN(value) AS max_delta
FROM unnested
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;
